Build a list of US-listed biotech companies that IPO'd on Nasdaq or NYSE during the period roughly JULY 2025 through DECEMBER 2025. ONLY include clinical-stage or commercial-stage DRUG DEVELOPERS (therapeutics). EXCLUDE: large pharma, healthcare services, pure diagnostics/devices companies, SPACs without a therapeutics target, tools/CRO companies.

For each company return:
- ticker
- company name
- approx IPO date (month/year ok)
- brief focus (lead asset / indication / modality if known)
- source (URL + date)

Cross-check tickers.

Flag anything you cannot verify as "unverified". Be concise. Return ONLY the structured list (ticker · company · date · focus · source URL+date). If your list is partial, say so. Do not write files; return findings as your final message.
